name: Mad Dagger
raw_text: Dagger only Type Active, Physical skill Element Weapon Dependent MP 200 $result_string .= sprintf("Aggro %s", $row['aggro_text']); Combo start Yes Combo middle Yes Range 16 Description Summons and controls a levitating dagger. Hurls the dagger at the target or a different target in combat to deal damage. After using the skill, the dagger follows you and delivers follow-up attacks in tandem with your normal attacks. Dagger After activating Mad Dagger, using Dagger Skills (excluding certain skills such as passives) will increase the number of levitating daggers.
